description: This file is a PHP source file that manages the web interface for configuring local IP settings, including IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, DHCP lease times, and related network parameters. It includes server-side PHP code for retrieving current network configurations and client-side JavaScript for form validation, dynamic UI updates, and AJAX calls to apply new settings.

methods.name: calcuate_lease_time
methods.description: Calculates DHCP lease time in seconds based on input number and unit.

methods.name: setIPconfiguration
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to apply new IPv4 network configuration.

methods.name: setIPv6configuration
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to apply new IPv6 network configuration.

methods.name: display_time_format
methods.description: Converts numeric lease time into human-readable form and updates form fields.

methods.name: display_time_format_V6
methods.description: Converts IPv6 lease time into human-readable form and updates form fields.

methods.name: populateIPv6Addr
methods.description: Parses and validates IPv6 address, preparing it for display or further processing.
